title: Rex Fleet Academy: Navigating the Mirrorfold
developmentStatus: Issue 1 is compiled and functions as a complete entry point. Continuation is optional and limited to at most two additional issues.
issueCountPolicy: Default to one issue. Add Issue 2 or 3 only for a distinct advanced-navigation or field-practicum problem that cannot be responsibly absorbed into Issue 1. Do not exceed three.
coreTeachingPromise: Navigation is epistemology under pressure: cadets learn what each instrument actually measures, what each observation proves, and how to build a safe decision from witnesses that may each be locally correct.
sourceTextProgram: See academy_source_program.json. Short technical/procedural extracts can establish a claim or operating rule; Edda Vale's instruction should then make cadets test the rule against folded geometry rather than merely repeat it.
coverDirection: Transfer of knowledge through an irresistible navigation demonstration: active learner, independent instruments, apparent contradiction, physical test, recognition.

courseArchitecture.castScope: Edda Vale and this navigation cohort are course-local unless explicitly reused elsewhere.
courseArchitecture.imgScope: Use a dedicated Navigating the Mirrorfold IMG/reference project when visual production begins.
